
```{r load packages}
# load librarian (package for installing/loading packages)
if (!require("librarian")) install.packages("librarian")

# load requried packages
librarian::shelf(here, # relative file paths
```

```{r explicitly assign functions if needed}
# make sure correct functions attached to the correct packages
summarize <- dplyr::summarize
group_by <- dplyr::group_by
select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r set seed}
set.seed(0429)
```

# Set the color palette and graphics

```{r consistent color palette by treatment}
colorz <- moma.colors("Warhol", n=15, type="discrete")
b.color <- colorz[3]
control.color <- colorz[9]
crab.color <- colorz[1]
n.color <- colorz[6]
```

```{r set graphing theme}
# ggplot theme
theme_set(
  theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black")) +
    theme(
      text       = element_text(size = 9, colour = "black"),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),  # default is gray
      axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.line  = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      plot.tag   = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.border = element_rect(color="black", fill = NA, size = 1),
      axis.title.y = element_markdown(lineheight = 0.8),
      axis.title.x = element_markdown(lineheight = 0.8))
)

# size for points
pt_size <- 1.2

# size for boxplot
bxp_size <- 0.5

# size for point range
ptrg_size <- 0.5
linrg_size <- 0.5
```

# Read in data

```{r load data}
physiology_1 <- read_csv(here("data", "physiology.csv"))

metadata <- read_csv(here("data", "metadata.csv")) 
```

# Make model

Join dataframes

```{r}
metadata %>% 
  inner_join(physiology_1) -> physiology_2
```

Create Tweedie GLMM

```{r model}
m.tl.full.1 <- glmmTMB(tissue_loss_5_percent ~ crab + nutrients + crab:nutrients + dflav_density_per_1000cm3 + gmono_density_per_1000cm3 + endosym_percent_change + (1|block), 
                  family = tweedie(link = "log"),
                  data = physiology_2)
```

```{r test assumptions}
# get residuals
resid.m.tl.full.1 <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m.tl.full.1)

testResiduals(resid.m.tl.full.1, plot = T)
testDispersion(resid.m.tl.full.1)
testZeroInflation(resid.m.tl.full.1)
testQuantiles(resid.m.tl.full.1, plot = T) 
plotResiduals(resid.m.tl.full.1)
check_model(resid.m.tl.full.1)
```

```{r examine results}
car::Anova(m.tl.full.1, type = 3)
```

```{r}
plot(emmeans(m.tl.full.1, pairwise ~ nutrients|crab))
  emmeans(m.tl.full.1, pairwise ~ nutrients|crab)
  
plot(emmeans(m.tl.full.1, pairwise ~ crab|nutrients))
  emmeans(m.tl.full.1, pairwise ~ crab|nutrients)
```


Get contrasts using emmeans

```{r}
emm.tl <- as_tibble(summary(emmeans::emmeans(m.tl.full.1, pairwise ~ nutrients|crab), type = "response")$emmeans) 
```

# Plot tissue loss differences (Panel A)

```{r}
metadata %>% 
  mutate(Crab = case_when(crab == "Y" ~ "Crab",
                               crab == "N" ~ "No crab")) %>%
  mutate(Nutrients = case_when(nutrients == "Y" ~ "Enriched",
                               nutrients == "N" ~ "Ambient")) %>% 
  mutate(Treatment = case_when(nutrients == "N" & crab == "N" ~ "Control", 
                               nutrients == "Y" & crab == "N" ~ "Nutrient",
                               nutrients == "N" & crab == "Y" ~ "Crab",
                               nutrients == "Y" & crab == "Y" ~ "Both"
                               )) -> metadata_2
```

Panel A

```{r}
emm.tl %>% 
  mutate(Treatment = case_when(nutrients == "N" & crab == "N" ~ "Control", 
                               nutrients == "Y" & crab == "N" ~ "Nutrient",
                               nutrients == "N" & crab == "Y" ~ "Crab",
                               nutrients == "Y" & crab == "Y" ~ "Both"
                               )) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_pointrange(aes(x = Treatment, y = response,
                      ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), 
                  color = "black", size = ptrg_size, linewidth = linrg_size,
                  position = position_dodge2(width = 0.75)) +
  # make a new color scale
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
  geom_point(aes(x = Treatment, y = tissue_loss_5_percent,
                 color = Treatment),
             size = pt_size,
             data = metadata_2,
             alpha = 0.7,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2,
                                             jitter.height = 0,
                                             dodge.width = 0.75)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Both" = b.color, "Nutrient" = n.color,
                                "Crab" = crab.color, "Control" = control.color)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ylab("Tissue loss (%)") +
  xlab("") -> panelA
```

# Plot D. flavicaudus across treatments (Panel B)

```{r}
metadata %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = dflav_density_per_1000cm3, y = tissue_loss_5_percent)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = treatment),
             size = pt_size,
             alpha = 0.7) +
  ylab("Tissue loss (%)") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Treatment",
                     values = c("Both" = b.color, "Nutrient" = n.color,
                                "Crab" = crab.color, "Control" = control.color)) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  xlab("*D. flavicaudus* density<br>(no. individuals/1000 cm<sup>3</sup>)") -> panelB
```


# Plot together

```{r}
cairo_pdf(here("figures", "Figure 5.pdf"), height = 2.5, width = 5.5)


panelA + panelB + 
   plot_annotation(title = "Figure 5",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10)),
                  tag_levels = c('a'), tag_prefix = '(',
                            tag_suffix = ')')


dev.off()
```
